content.intro: Anonymous Methods and Method Groups is lesson 104 in Delegates, Lambdas, Events, and Functional Features. A method names a unit of behavior, with explicit inputs and an explicit result or side effect. Keep its responsibility narrow and test meaningful edge cases.
content.why_it_matters: Separating a behavior from the code that invokes it supports callbacks, event-driven systems, and composition. This lesson focuses on anonymous methods and method groups and shows how to verify the behavior instead of relying on assumptions.
